items.title: Randy Brecker interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 12, 2022
items.q: Mike was playing away on one tune, burning, with Louis Hayes on drums

ctx.x: And I don’t remember the name of the tune but he gave us the lecture before we started about, “I don’t want to hear too many notes, I don’t want to hear 16th notes. You know keep your solos short. And Mike was playing away on one tune, burning, with Louis Hayes on drums, Ron Carter on bass, and Horace stopped the take and made us start over. “Too many notes, I told you, I don’t want 16th notes.”
